prose: Is AI a sentient threat, or a digital mirror? Mike Winner (TerrainTV, Alfavedic) returns to InnerVerse to 'de-hex' the mainstream narrative of the AI age. From the 'AI Psychosis' trapping truth-seekers to the way digital tools can noticeably impair our cognitive ability if used as an outsourcing agent, we explore why discernment is your most powerful biological technology. This is a deep-dive into first principles: why technology is a plagiarization of nature, and how we can use these tools to reclaim our sovereignty without losing our souls to the black mirror.
